Name: Witch's Valley
Author: PoppiPan
Description:
[b]UPDATED VERSION!!
Only one problem remains: Json Assets (I think) resets all added items after quitting and restarting the game. For this reason, all mahcines in progress when you leave the game will glitch and not produce an item. I recommend you never leave the game with in progress items (sorry!) until the issue is fixed!
[/b]
Hello everyone, and thank you for your patience!

After my first mod, Poppi's Kawaii Valley, I decided to work on another theme!
This one took a while longer since I had to make it compatible with the new Stardew update, but it should work just fine!

The installation and recipes are all in the file, and this mod has no requirements aside from JSON Assests and Custom Farming Redux.
[b]SOME RECIPES ARE A LITTLE GLITCHY AND WILL TAKE CLAY OR FIBER INSTEAD OF GLASS! (I couldn't find the problem and fix it, sorry!)[/b]

Enjoy making cute sigils, glass works, sachet, and many other items!
